findings.text: follow-on: the manifest's changed_paths names reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/crew/promotion.py, but git diff --stat 81b5353..e67ec7d is empty for both, so a reader reconciling changed_paths against the diff finds two entries the landed change does not contain.

follow-on: section_attempts_by_plan loads the whole ledger and every live pointer on each delivered plan view; the run's paired view-timing logs record the roadmap build rising from 28.06s at base to 31.55s at head, adding roughly twelve percent to a read for a count that moves only when a run launches or completes.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; the launch-counting commits (faca5b63, da7ff47cd) and their dispatch-side plan write were reverted by d2b52e548/1a3c4ef9, leaving a derived read plus a write-time strip of the legacy attempts attribute (reckon/_store.py:1389).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's four outcomes are asserted by tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py:157-262 (two dispatches and one promotion leave attempts at 2; a resume leaves it unchanged; outcomes are recorded; the stored plan carries no counter), and the manifest records the head gate at 208 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is SS4's tool-owned attempt counter; the delta derives the count from crew run history (reckon/mcp_views.py:1472 section_attempts_by_plan) and surfaces it on delivered plan reads (reckon/serve.py:3044) and the roadmap ready set (reckon/roadmap.py:2874) rather than incrementing it at dispatch.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at orientation; status complete, commits ending e67ec7d, baseline_suite revision 81b5353 (11 failed) and after_suite revision e67ec7d (0 failed), negative control whose last line reads EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the net diff 81b5353..e67ec7d changes 9 files, all inside the node's granted set once the six-file test widening the manifest records is included; reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/crew/promotion.py are named in changed_paths but show no net change.

justifications.durability: tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py:157-262 asserts the derived count against independently dispatched run ids, and the negative-control-derived-final.log mutation (drop implement/test rows and raw pointers) reddens that case at EXIT=1.
justifications.evidence: the node's after-suite-widened-final.log records 208 passed EXIT=0 at e67ec7d against baseline-suite-widened-final.log at 11 failed EXIT=1 at 81b5353, and my independent run of tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py reported 7 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: the new symbols (section_attempts_by_plan, with_section_attempts) name the mechanism, the commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no AI trailer, and no plan or sprint identifier reaches source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_views.py:1472 derives attempts and outcomes from distinct implement/test run ids and reckon/roadmap.py:2874 exposes them in the ready set, but dispatch (reckon/crew/dispatch.py) and complete no longer write the section counter, so the plan's tool-owned counter is realised as a derived view.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 81b5353..e67ec7d returns exactly the 9 changed files, none outside the granted set, though reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/crew/promotion.py appear in the manifest's changed_paths with no net change.
